summary_1line: Drona receives Parashurama’s weapons, is humiliated by King Drupada, then reveals his skill to the Kuru princes and is recognized by Bhishma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Drona stands by a dry well before the Kuru princes, launching blades of grass one after another to form a chain that lifts their lost ball.
King Drupada sits proudly on his throne, brows furrowed and eyes red with anger as he scornfully rejects the poor Brahmana Drona claiming friendship.
Young Aswatthaman dances with joy holding a bowl of rice-water, believing it to be milk while other children laugh around him.
